text: Before autosquash, snapshot branch/HEAD/status, prove all fixups target the intended commit, enumerate dependent refs/worktrees, and use `git -c rebase.updateRefs=false rebase --interactive --autosquash --no-update-refs --no-autostash --empty=keep <base>` when dependents must not move. Verify parent, tree, message, author/date, changed refs, clean status, and no pending Git operation. [Task 4]
